searchText: ie forkchoiceUpdatedV1 is useless once Capella ships. that's a good point i was mainly thinking that this would simplify the logic in the consensus side for determining which method to call. It depends how you look at it really. If your CL code is setup to treat all methods as a single group then having it reported as a single group is easier - if they're more independent it's easier to have the independent list. even if we could query 'is this specific method supported' would be a plus... but i think an array of supported functions is what i'd ideally like I was on team version-bundling, but I'm feeling persuaded by the individual method argument. I think it's not too much complexity Churning the whole API with each release would be quite annoying and we may as well stay consistent with the beacon-APIs way of doing things What we're doing to avoid any problems until the last minute is call V1 right up to the fork, and start calling V2 at the fork Yeah that works fine. Personally I like finding problems as far before the fork as possible but there's a benefits to both approaches. 🙂
